content: Tauri v2 bundle.macOS.files maps destination (relative to Contents/) to source, so Library/LaunchAgents/<label>.plist can be shipped; externalBin sidecars need -<target-triple> suffix and land next to main executable. tauri-plugin-autostart launches the whole app (LaunchAgent plist in ~/Library/LaunchAgents or AppleScript), not a headless helper.
